title: Pianists she works with nowadays
summary: She names Dill Jones, Marty Napoleon and the musicians who know where to fit behind her.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yes. There are even, you know, when you get down to the nitty-gritty, there are certain accompanists that you would prefer, you know, rather than others. Although at this particular point I worked with a lot of accompanists, pianists, and right now I've got about twenty piano players that I would just as soon work with and it's not likely that I'm going to work with anybody else 'cause they all show up one place or the other.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

There's Dill Jones, there's Marty Napoleon. Of course I've done a lot of things with Dick Hyman in the background; and at this particular point I might go some place and appear on a gig and I look and there's one of the guys that I know, and they already know my music. John Bunch, Jimmy Andrews who was at Condon's and I feel very comfortable with all of them and I think what happens, if I run into a piano player with whom I haven't worked before, I don't care how good he is, we're going to have problems, you see.

In time -- that depends on how much time you have to work with them and I think I've been fortunate because I don't necessarily have a group of musicians of my own to carry around behind me. I had the good fortunate to work with a lot of the greats. Hank Jones, Ellis Larkin, of course there was nothing wrong with Billy Kyle and Derek Smith --
You did a TV show with him; but let's not get into that now.
We've got to save something for next time.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Let's see, who did I work with last -- all right, last night in Larchmont I worked with Gene Rodgers who is a very good pianist and I haven't seen Gene in forty years, the last time I saw Gene we worked together in Chicago at a club and he was accompanying and working with -- they had a comedy act -- Radcliffe and Rodgers. But we would have sessions together, you know, after work, he was a very good pianist. So he showed up last night.

So as I said before, I've been quite lucky. The guys seem to know where I'm going and there's no clashes and no problems. It would be easier -- I can't even think of any bad ones -- to think up a bad one would be to think up the good ones.
